directAnswer: General contractor SEO is the work of helping a renovation and building business rank in search so the right homeowners find it. For Canadian contractors that means whole-project service pages, a strong Google Business Profile, and province-aware pages that help someone searching in their own city book with you.
intro: A general contractor is hired to run a renovation or build from start to finish: whole-home and multi-trade renovations, kitchens and bathrooms as part of a bigger project, basement renovations, additions and structural changes. The contractor manages the schedule, coordinates the subtrades, tracks budgets and change orders, handles permits and inspections on the client's behalf, and sees the project through to handover. Homeowners buying that kind of work search to find someone they can trust with a large project. They compare contractors on past projects, reviews and how clearly they communicate, and they often start with a search such as "general contractor" plus a city, or "home renovation contractor" plus a city. A contractor's website, project galleries and Google Business Profile are what get found for those searches, long before anyone asks for a referral.
localInsight: Canada is ten provinces, and renovation demand does not behave the same way in all of them. Big cities such as Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver and Calgary carry the most search volume, but demand is also spread across smaller cities and regions, especially once the building season starts. Cold winters shape the season across most of Canada, while coastal BC is milder and wetter than the Prairies. In Quebec, French-language search matters; these pages are published in English. Homeowners comparing contractors look for proof of past work, clear communication and a local presence, so a national hub has to link down to real province and city pages instead of trying to cover the whole country from one page.
localChecklist: A service page for each kind of project you actually run, from whole-home renovations to additions
Project galleries and past-job photography organised by project type
A Google Business Profile set to your real service area, not the whole country
Consistent business details everywhere your contractor business appears online
Reviews from past renovation clients, kept current and honest
Clear contact and quote-request steps on every page

faqs.q: What is general contractor SEO in Canada?
faqs.a: It is search optimisation built for contractors who run whole projects rather than a single trade. It combines service pages for each kind of renovation or build, local visibility work and a well-managed Google Business Profile so that a homeowner searching for a general contractor nearby can find and choose your business.

faqs.q: How is a general contractor different from a plumber, roofer or electrician?
faqs.a: A single trade does one kind of work. A general contractor is hired to run the whole project: scheduling, subtrade coordination, budgets, change orders, permits and inspections handled on the client's behalf, and handover. Kitchens and bathrooms are included when they are part of a larger renovation, not sold as isolated room jobs.

faqs.q: Do you work with general contractors in every province?
faqs.a: Yes. We work with general contractors across Canada, remotely from St. Catharines, Ontario. We build pages for Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, and Prince Edward Island, and we link each province page to the cities we cover inside it.

faqs.q: Why do directory sites outrank my own website?
faqs.a: Large directories and marketplaces have enormous authority, so they often sit above a single business for broad terms. The strategy is not to fight them for a generic word but to win the specific searches that describe your work, your clients and your location.

faqs.q: What kinds of projects can you write about?
faqs.a: We write only about work you genuinely offer: whole-home and multi-trade renovations, kitchens and bathrooms within a larger project, basement renovations, additions and structural changes. We do not invent services or make claims a business cannot stand behind.

faqs.q: How long before a contractor sees results?
faqs.a: Local visibility usually starts improving within three to six months, with more meaningful gains between six and twelve months. Timelines depend on your current site, the competition in your city, and how consistently content and profile work is maintained.

faqs.q: Do you guarantee a number one ranking?
faqs.a: No ethical provider can guarantee a specific position, because search results change constantly. We follow a proven process, measure the results that matter such as enquiries and booked projects, and report them transparently.

summary: General contractor SEO in Canada. Whole-project pages, profile work and province-aware pages that help Canadian contractors get found locally.
